title: Prisma Schema — Faq→CourseFaq rename + GeneralFaqCategory + GeneralFaq models
content:
Phase 2 的 FAQ 系統需要獨立的資料庫模型。同時將現有的 course-scoped Faq 更名為 CourseFaq 以釐清職責。

Prisma 變更：
1. 重新命名現有 Faq model 為 CourseFaq，@@map("course_faqs")，更新 Course 上的關聯欄位名稱
2. 新增 GeneralFaqCategory model：id, nameZh, nameEn, nameZhCn?, order, createdAt, updatedAt
3. 新增 GeneralFaq model：id, categoryId (FK→GeneralFaqCategory, cascade), questionZh, questionEn, questionZhCn?, answerZh, answerEn, answerZhCn?, order, isPublished, createdAt, updatedAt

更新所有 rename 參照（14 個檔案）：
- prisma/seed.ts：faqs → courseFaqs
- src/lib/validation/course.ts：faqSchema → courseFaqSchema, faqs → courseFaqs in courseCreateSchema
- src/components/courses/types.ts：DetailedCourse.faqs → DetailedCourse.courseFaqs
- src/lib/map-course-detail.ts：faqs → courseFaqs, ApiFaq 相關屬性
- src/components/courses/CourseHiddenSections.tsx：course.faqs → course.courseFaqs
- src/app/api/admin/courses/route.ts
- src/app/api/admin/courses/[id]/route.ts
- src/app/api/courses/route.ts
- src/app/api/courses/[slug]/route.ts

Seed data：加入示範 GeneralFaqCategory（報名、付款、證書等類別）與 GeneralFaq 條目。

風險：高 — rename 會觸及 14 個檔案與資料庫 migration。
acceptance: Prisma migration creates CourseFaq, GeneralFaqCategory, GeneralFaq tables with correct fields and relations
Existing Faq model renamed to CourseFaq with @@map("course_faqs")
All 14 files updated to use courseFaqs instead of faqs for course-scoped FAQ references
Seed creates sample GeneralFaqCategory + GeneralFaq entries
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: prisma/schema.prisma (update — rename Faq→CourseFaq, add GeneralFaqCategory + GeneralFaq)
prisma/seed.ts (update — rename references, add general FAQ seed data)
verification: npx prisma migrate dev --name add_general_faq && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
